name: Realistic Hair
desc:
Your avatar now has REAL physics-based hair, and you can completely ruin it—burn it in campfires, freeze and shatter it, or dip it in dye vats! Just a heads-up, all those real-time strands mean you might need a decent PC or device to run it smoothly. Customize your look in the HAIR tab, grab the Game Passes, and leave a like if your hair caught fire!                                                                                                                               THE SALON UPDATE
- NEW Hair Salon: grab tools at the counter, sit under a hood dryer, or get a shampoo at the wash sink
- NEW tools: Electric Clippers, Hairspray, Dye Balloons
- Better Hair Dryer: the air moves the exact strands it hits, with HOT and COOL modes
- Better Scissors: snip the exact strand you click or tap, even on your own hair
- Improved controls for phones and tablets
- Lots of bug fixes
